name: @pipeworx/mcp-boj

tools.name: boj_policy_rate
tools.description: The Bank of Japan's current policy interest rate for JAPAN (the BOJ short-term policy rate / Monetary Policy-Related Interest Rate, % per annum). Returns the latest value, its month, and recent monthly history. Use this for any 'Bank of Japan interest rate' / 'BOJ rate' / 'Japan policy rate' question. Sourced from IMF IFS (keyless). As of mid-2026 the rate is 0.5% (BOJ exited negative rates in 2024 and hiked to 0.5% in Jan 2025).

months.description: How many recent months of history to return (default 12).

tools.name: boj_inflation
tools.description: Japan's consumer price inflation (CPI, all items) — the metric the Bank of Japan targets at 2%. Returns the latest year-on-year inflation rate (%), the latest CPI index level, their month, and recent monthly history. Use for 'Japan inflation rate' / 'Japan CPI' / 'is Japan hitting the BOJ 2% target' questions. Sourced from IMF IFS (keyless).

months.description: How many recent months of history to return (default 12).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-boj forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the boj pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
